title: Launcher focused runs bind to a stale work item the session no longer holds, not to its current Engram focus or claim
outcome: A focused launcher run in a named source root is bound to the session's current Engram focus or claimed item for that root. It is never bound to a stale earlier item that the session has handed off and that another holder now holds.
acceptance: C1. For a new launcher registration and matching host command observation, work attribution comes from a current held claim with its effective named source root matching the actual validated execution worktree. A stale cached binding for a handed-off item or another root is never attached; shared-root selection uses the unambiguous focused carrier and preserves existing batch-member rules.

C2. A failed, timed-out, incomplete, ambiguous or raced claim/root validation attaches no work binding and reports that uncertainty. It never falls back to a stale cache or declares an Engram-configured project safely unbound. Validation uses the existing read-only held-claims and root owners off StateInner and revalidates local ownership before publication.

C3. Registration and host-observation summary enrichment agree on attribution. Retries preserve the first immutable run association; deferred command descriptions and completions do not adopt later claims. Existing historical run identities/artifacts are preserved.

C4. Attribution refresh performs no forced session bind, control toggle, grant/debt mutation or new verification-credit issuance. Eligible prospective checks settle only through the existing authority, source-root, exact-input and writer-fencing owners; ineligible or uncertain checks remain uncredited with an explicit reason. Scripted tests cover C1-C4, including Base/OFF and gated sessions and concurrent handoff/root changes.
C5. The independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding and the standard full gate passes on the exact landing input.

completion.summary: Current-holder committed-input launcher attribution landed in Combo25 fa26ee07. No acceptance evaluation exists. Exact-tree dual-host FULLs and final independent pair support C1-C5; historical failures and severities remain preserved, optional Lows filed.
